title: Club Membership: missed-payment retry timing by tier
content:
## Scope
This document states, for every Club Membership tier, how many days after a failed dues charge the system retries collection, and how many retry attempts are allowed before the membership is marked past due.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Days after a failed charge before the system retries collection | Maximum retry attempts before the membership is marked past due |
|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | 5 | 2 |
| Student Metro Access | 5 | 2 |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | 5 | 2 |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | 5 | 2 |
| Premier All-Access | 5 | 3 |
| Black Card All-Access | 7 | 3 |
| Founding Legacy Access | 7 | 3 |

## Reading the table
Each retry attempt is spaced apart by the tier's own retry-days figure; once the tier's own maximum retry-attempts figure is reached without a successful collection, the membership is marked past due.
